sentences.en: Poor sanitation practices rendered Europe helpless against the Black Death.

sentences.en: Algerian sanitation workers have their work cut out for them.

sentences.en: Sanitation is a very important part of public health.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生中，卫生非常重要。
